events.title: Halloween GOTV with OCDP!
events.description: 🎃 GET OUT THE BOO! Halloween GOTV with OCDP! 👻 SIGN UP HERE: https://midems.controlshift.app/events/halloween-gotv-with-ocdp-1 No tricks, just treats, yard signs, and Election Day resources! Join the Oakland County Democratic Party on Friday, October 30, from 12 PM–4 PM for a Halloween-themed afternoon at the OCDP office! Here's what you can expect: 🍬 Halloween candy and treats 🪧 Yard signs available for pickup 🗳️ Election Day literature and voter resources ✅ Early voting information and assistance Costumes are welcome! Whether you're stopping by for a sweet treat, picking up a yard sign, or looking for voting information, we'd love to see you! 📅 Friday, October 30, 2026 ⏰ 12:00 PM–4:00 PM 📍 Oakland County Democratic Party Office 17100 W. 12 Mile Road, Suite 5 Southfield, MI 48076 Early voting continues through November 1, and Election Day is Tuesday, November 3. No tricks. Just treats! See you Friday! 🎃

events.title: November Membership Meeting
events.location: The Hawk Community Center | 29995 W 12 Mile Rd, Farmington Hills, MI 48334, USA | Farmington Hills | MI | 48334
events.description: Join us for our General Membership Meeting. Social hour is at 6:30 and the meeting starts at 7:00. We will have a guest speaker and a current elected official provide a legislative update. Come meet fellow Democrats and find a way to get involved! We will meet in the Meeting Room on the 3rd Floor of The Hawk Community Center located at 29995 W 12 Mile Road, Farmington Hills MI 48334. You must enter through the main entrance and take the elevator to the third floor. The back parking lot door is closed.
